# Single pinned CRAN snapshot for every workflow in this repository.
#
# Posit Package Manager serves an immutable, date-stamped view of CRAN. Pinning
# the date pins the resolved version of every CRAN package and of every
# transitive dependency, which is what makes a clean runner reproducible. The
# `__linux__/noble` prefix additionally serves prebuilt Ubuntu 24.04 binaries so
# a clean restore does not depend on compiler behaviour.
#
# Change this date only in a commit that also records why. Do not add a second
# repository: a package resolved from an unpinned mirror is not reproducible.
https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/noble/2026-07-01
